entry.title: New: dsh-conversation-minimap
entry.summary: A conversation minimap for the DSH Web GUI (ChatGPT desktop style): one evenly-spaced capsule anchor per user prompt, fish-eye bell-curve magnification on hover with full prompt preview, top/bottom edge fade, blue highlight that follows the current prompt, click to jump to the message, and automatic full-history loading. Exact install spec: github:braidy-wu/dsh-conversation-minimap. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
